🚀 Project Update: Helmet Detection using OpenCV & YOLOv8 🚀

Excited to share my latest project where I developed a robust Helmet Detection system. The core of this project utilizes the YOLOv8 object detection framework, alongside Python, OpenCV, and Ultralytics for image inference. It was trained on images and videos of construction sites – a surprisingly complex dataset.

The biggest surprise? Adapting the model to varying lighting conditions and helmet styles proved significantly more challenging than anticipated. The system integrates with supervision and employs deep learning techniques to improve accuracy.

Initially, the model achieved [your mAP score] on our validation set. However, deploying it in real-world scenarios revealed the critical need for extensive, diverse training data. This underscored the importance of understanding the nuances of real-world accuracy.

What are the most common challenges you've encountered when deploying object detection models in practical applications? Let’s discuss!
